forces: Node applications require concrete implementations of Core platform SPIs without violating Core's platform neutrality.
AsyncLocalStorage context propagation must ensure strict isolation across concurrent asynchronous execution chains without cross-scope data leakage.
Shutdown timers must support unref to avoid retaining host processes while strictly avoiding the installation of process signal handlers.
The package must maintain standalone repository topology with zero third-party runtime dependencies and private unlicensed status.
The package public API must remain explicitly provisional and unfrozen until vertical evidence is established under PLAN-047.

evidence_ids: Node SPI providers implement all Core SPIs and reproduce pre-split behavior in equivalence tests
Child-process tests prove concurrent asynchronous operations under AsyncLocalStorage do not leak context
Child-process shutdown test proves process exits cleanly with scheduled timer and without signal handlers

security_justification.audit_integrity: Preserves all canonical event construction and validation invariants by delegating to Core while providing verified Node host capabilities.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Context provider propagates authoritative context frames without fabricating or modifying caller authorization attributes.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Core brand registry and brand validation remain authoritative; the Node binding provides host execution context without minting brands.
security_justification.concurrency: AsyncLocalStorage guarantees isolated execution scopes across concurrent asynchronous workflows without cross-scope contamination.
security_justification.confidentiality: No sensitive payload data, credentials, or audit event details are logged, leaked, or retained in provider state.
security_justification.cryptography: Identifiers are strictly generated using cryptographically strong RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs via node:crypto.randomUUID().
security_justification.error_disclosure: Structured error categories and safe error mappings are preserved; provider errors do not disclose host memory or credentials.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external transports, network collectors, SIEM agents, or telemetry exporters are authorized or introduced.
security_justification.fail_posture: Missing context or invalid configuration fails closed before event construction or emission.
security_justification.lifecycle: Shutdown timers support unref() to ensure idle process retention does not occur, without installing process signal handlers.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Provider objects and configurations are immutable; context frame transitions return new references without in-place mutation.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Prohibited data policies and transformation hooks in Core remain strictly enforced without alteration by the Node binding.
security_justification.resource_retention: AsyncLocalStorage scopes and unref timer handles clean up automatically upon execution completion, preventing resource leaks.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No automated retry, queuing, or buffering mechanisms are introduced.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The trust boundary between the Node.js runtime host and the semantic Core is strictly formalized through SPI implementations.
